note: Prompts for a candidate agent. test_record.py checks the record checker, parser and overview separately; these check how the editor keeps the record and routes questions.

evals.name: start-a-record-for-an-orchestrated-project
evals.prompt: I'm running this project with three lane threads. Keep a running record of work done and remaining that the lanes can follow, and only you edit it.
evals.expected_output: Looks for an existing record first, starts one from the template with every section, asks for the source ladder if it is not known, sets up a mirror the lanes can read when they cannot open the record, runs record.py check, and renders and embeds the overview.
assertions: no_parallel_record: checks for an existing record before creating one
all_sections: the record has Where things stand, Lanes, How open questions get answered, Needs <Owner>, Decisions already approved, Answered by research, Stopped, Lane work, Done and Last updated
single_editor: the record states that only the editor edits it and that lanes report by message
mirror_when_needed: lanes that cannot read the record get the orphan-branch STATUS.md mirror and its read command
checked: record.py check runs and prints PASS before the reply

evals.name: owner-edited-the-record-meanwhile
evals.prompt: Lane 3 just reported ticket 60 delivered at 084daf3 with CI green. Update the record. (The owner ruled on the bars question in the browser ten minutes ago.)
evals.expected_output: Re-reads the current revision before editing, keeps the owner's ruling exactly as written, adds a Done row with the checks and CI result linking the commit, updates Lanes and Lane work, sets Last updated, updates the mirror and re-renders the overview.
assertions: reread_first: reads the record's current revision immediately before the edit
keeps_owner_ruling: the owner's ruling text is unchanged in the new revision
done_row: the Done row has the date, what landed with its checks and CI result, and the linked commit
mirror_matches: the STATUS.md mirror gets the same change
no_force: does not force a write over a newer revision

evals.name: question-goes-through-research-first
evals.prompt: Lane 2 asks whether a returned Airflow record is a new Job or the same one. Get it answered.
evals.expected_output: Does not ask the owner straight away. Starts a read-only research thread with the brief and the source ladder; records a settled answer as open to veto, or adds a full decision item under Needs <Owner> with sources, recommendation, why and what it holds up.
assertions: research_before_owner: a research thread or subagent checks the sources before the owner is asked
ladder_order: the brief lists the sources in the record's order and says read only
complete_item: an item that reaches the owner has question, context, sources checked with citations, recommendation, why with tradeoff, and holding up
veto_label: an answer the sources settle is recorded under Answered by research as open to the owner's veto

evals.name: owner-rules
evals.prompt: Approved A on the ID question.
evals.expected_output: Checks the item off in place with a dated ruling first, keeps the recommendation and why beneath it, adds a Done row for the ruling, tells the affected lane, and updates the mirror and overview.
assertions: in_place: the item stays where it is and is checked off
dated_ruling: the ruling and its date are recorded on the item
lane_told: the lane the item was holding up is sent the ruling
